title: Clinical efficacy of accelerated vs. standard H1-coil TMS dosing: a prospective, multisite, 12-month durability study
title_zh: 加速与标准H1线圈TMS剂量的临床疗效：前瞻性多中心12个月耐久性研究
abstract: BACKGROUND: A recent multicenter trial compared five-times-daily accelerated intermittent theta burst stimulation (ACC-iTBS) deep TMS with standard-of-care high-frequency (SOC-HF) deep TMS in adults with MDD. The goal of the current study was to assess the long-term durability of these outcomes over one year. METHODS: Response and remission rates based on the clinician-rated HDRS-21 and MADRS were assessed at 3, 6, 9 and 12 months. Mood, anxiety, and quality of life were assessed with the CUDOS, CUXOS, and Q-LES-Q-SF, and rates of medication change and additional TMS were recorded. RESULTS: Sixty-five of 89 parent-trial completers (73%) consented to the durability study. At 12 months, HDRS-21 response/remission were 94.4%/83.3% for ACC-iTBS and 88.0%/88.0% for SOC-HF. The longitudinal HDRS-21 group-by-time interaction was not significant (F=0.3622, p=0.7804; approximate partial eta-squared=0.011). Across follow-up, PHQ-9 remission ranged from 53%-77% (ACC-iTBS) and 33%-58% (SOC-HF), while CUXOS remission ranged from 68%-85% and 61%-83%, respectively. At 12 months, Q-LES-Q-SF scores were >=73% in 68.4% of ACC-iTBS and 76.9% of SOC-HF participants, while severe impairment (<=60.2%) was present in 0% and 11.5%, respectively. Eighty percent of participants had no medication increase/augmentation, 80% received no additional TMS, and 66% required neither. CONCLUSIONS: Clinical improvement in depression, anxiety, and quality of life persisted for at least one year following both accelerated and standard high-frequency deep TMS with the H1 coil.
abstract_zh: 背景：最近一项多中心试验比较了每天五次加速间歇性Theta波刺激（ACC-iTBS）深TMS与标准高频（SOC-HF）深TMS在成人重度抑郁症（MDD）中的疗效。本研究旨在评估这些疗效在一年内的长期耐久性。方法：基于临床评定的HDRS-21和MADRS，在3、6、9和12个月评估了响应和缓解率。使用CUDOS、CUXOS和Q-LES-Q-SF评估情绪、焦虑和生活质量，并记录了药物变更和额外TMS的使用情况。结果：89名父研究完成者中有65人（73%）同意参加耐久性研究。在12个月时，HDRS-21的响应/缓解率分别为ACC-iTBS组94.4%/83.3%，SOC-HF组88.0%/88.0%。纵向HDRS-21组别×时间交互作用不显著（F=0.3622，p=0.7804；近似部分eta平方=0.011）。在随访期间，PHQ-9缓解率ACC-iTBS组为53%-77%，SOC-HF组为33%-58%，而CUXOS缓解率分别为68%-85%和61%-83%。12个月时，Q-LES-Q-SF评分≥73%的ACC-iTBS参与者占68.4%，SOC-HF组占76.9%，而严重损害（≤60.2%）分别为0%和11.5%。80%的参与者药物未增加/增量，80%未接受额外TMS，66%两者皆未需要。结论：经过加速和标准高频深TMS治疗后，抑郁、焦虑和生活质量的临床改善至少持续了一年。
